resources.string: Connect to the internet to create a request or check progress. Reconnecting will not submit a transfer.
Transferred without creating a request? Contact AxiaPay support for investigation.
Funding is not available right now. Existing requests remain available below.
Your request may already be saved. Retry with the same details or refresh your request history.
Transfer the exact amount to this account, then submit your transfer reference below.
Enter the copied account and amount in OPay. Transfer details are not prefilled. Returning here does not confirm payment.
OPay could not be opened. Copy the account number and transfer using your banking app, then return to submit the reference.
Your request is saved for review. No need to contact support separately. Your balance changes only after the credit is confirmed.
Check the amount, funding option and required details.
Your session changed. Sign in again to view your requests.
The request could not be changed. Refresh to see its saved status and reference.
Could not confirm the outcome. Refresh progress or retry the same request when connected.
